evidence.quote: Postponements of such reports could complicate things for the Fed
which has insisted it will make upcoming decisions on interest rates based on what incoming data say about the economy.
With inflation down from its peak two summers ago
Wall Street is hopeful that the Federal Reserve may finally be done with its market-shaking hikes to interest rates and could soon turn to cutting them.
